limitations: External network, workers, service workers, WebSockets and live integrations are blocked. Dependency failures under this isolation are not application defects.
Startup and DOM inventory only; no financial, mining, transaction or other action controls activated.
Fresh ephemeral context; persistence across sessions and authenticated integrations not exercised.
